cues.en: This story began when I learned three

cues.en: But before we look at how Roblox treats its workers, first, we have to look at how Roblox turns its young users into workers in the first place. So the good thing about Roblox, as I've said, is that the tools are free. The hosting's free. The tools actually let you skip with the traditional learning curve associated with three d modeling, and Roblox even handles moderation of your players for you. But people just using these free tools to get creative doesn't make Roblox any money. In fact, it loses the money because servers are expensive, which is why the moment that Roblox's core player base of nine to 15 year olds start playing, they are submerged in this idea that they could be an entrepreneur.

Oh, the catharsis of actually getting to turn work into something. But at least now it was worth something because we've been able to talk about it and tell everyone...... Fine
cues.zh: 你还能看到所有酷炫的回报，比如“坏主意屋”（Bad Idea House），这是一个常规栏目，我和 Chris 会在里面分享那些我们做过调研，但由于种种原因没能做成视频的故事。哦，把这些工作成果转化成某种东西真是太解脱了。但至少现在它有了价值，因为我们能够谈论它并把它讲给每个人听……好吧，

cues.en: people. Yeah. Thanks again everybody. And that link was patreon.com/peoplemakegames.
cues.zh: 各位。是的。再次感谢大家。刚才的链接是 patreon.com/peoplemakegames。
